0022600122.text: Dallas (1-2) visits Miami (0-3) for its fourth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 12th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, after a loss in its most recent game. Miami, 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, has dropped three straight and is 0-2 at home. The Mavericks are missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Cooper Flagg is day-to-day with a shoulder sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with Dallas winning the most recent meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
